title: Sheet Pan Chicken Kebab Wraps with Garlic Sauce
summary: Lean chicken mince mixed with diced onion, red pepper, garlic and spices, pressed flat on a lined tray, divided into eight kebabs and oven-baked, then wrapped in Lebanese wraps with a fresh tomato-cucumber-red-onion salad and a yoghurt-mayo garlic sauce. Louis Howard's review/recreation of a recipe credited to @panaceapalm; he rates it 10/10.
serves: 4 kebab wraps (description); the demonstrated tray is divided into 8 kebabs, 2 per wrap

ingredients.item: Lean chicken mince (5% fat or less)

steps.text: Finely dice the brown onion and red pepper and mince the garlic; squeeze out excess water from the diced vegetables as demonstrated.
Add the vegetables to the lean chicken mince with the chopped coriander, all the seasonings and the olive oil.
Mix thoroughly until the mixture changes colour.
Spread the mixture onto a lined baking tray (spoken: 'a greased sheet pan'), pressing it into a flat, even layer and adding finger marks as demonstrated.
Using a spatula, divide the sheet into eight kebabs.
Bake for 20–25 minutes at 190°C, draining any excess juices halfway through, until fully cooked and golden. On-screen card: 'OVEN BAKE' / '190C | 20-25 MINS' (pp bake-014/016).
Slice the baked chicken sheet into kebab-sized strips.

On-screen card: '1/2 tsp pepper'.
On-screen card: '1/2 lemon juice'.

steps.text: Mix the Greek yoghurt, light mayo, garlic powder, dill, salt, pepper and lemon juice in a bowl.
Add a splash of water until the sauce reaches a creamy consistency. Louis uses a blender because it is already out ('I'm feeling lazy', 1:21-1:22) — the written method says mix in a bowl.

ingredients.note: No quantity given in the written salad list.

steps.text: Combine the red onion, cherry tomatoes, cucumber, coriander and a little salt in a bowl.

ingredients.note: Description states approximately 200 calories each; no brand or size given.

steps.text: Spread garlic sauce on each Lebanese wrap.
Add two chicken kebabs per wrap.
Add the salad and more garlic sauce, then wrap up.

nutrition.note: Approximate creator-reported figures from the description ('Approximate macros per kebab wrap'). The hook frame shows '62G PROTEIN' (control-proven vision read of f-002, vision/read-hook.txt; raw OCR '62.') and the narration says 'over 60 grams of protein' (0:03-0:05, continuous across caption segments) — consistent with 62g. The end-of-video 'macros' panel never renders legible calorie/carb/fat digits in any sampled frame (t=104-126s; vision/read-macros.txt confirms 'no legible macro numbers'), so 586/45/16 rest on the description alone. Not independently calculated; the unquantified sweet-chilli jam addition and parsley swap are not included.

notes: Louis Howard's description credits @panaceapalm (YouTube channel 'Panacea Palm', resolved 200). This capture documents Louis's public review/recreation; the credited original was not independently audited.
Louis's verdict: 'BLOODY LOVELY! 10/10!' — 'this is a 10 out of 10. Definitely give it a go.' (2:00).

Personal substitutions demonstrated but NOT in the written spec: parsley instead of coriander in the chicken mix (0:29-0:32, on-screen 'parsley' card), sweet-chilli jam added to the wrap ('Sorry, I've got to add some sweet chili jam with this as well. It's begging for it.', 1:27-1:30), and blending the sauce instead of bowl-mixing (1:21).

The tray is divided into 8 kebabs (spoken 0:52-0:54 + on-screen '8 KEBABS' card, OCR f-014/bake-005..010) and assembled 2 per wrap (spoken 'Two chicken kebabs', 1:30) — consistent with 4 wraps from 1kg mince.
On-screen sauce card (t=72-79s) matches the written sauce list line-for-line except the splash of water, which is spoken only.

Louis wears an 'EMPLOYEE OF THE MONTH' t-shirt throughout (recurring shirt text, confirmed by vision/read-macros.txt; raw OCR fragments 'EMPLOYEE OF', 'EMPLGYEE OF'); a separate 'macros' overlay label appears over the end panel. Both are channel/wardrobe branding, not recipe content.
gaps: Coriander quantities (chicken mix and salad) are unstated in every surface.
Oven mode (fan/conventional) is unstated; 190°C is explicit in both the description and the on-screen card.
No on-screen quantity card for the diced vegetables (onion, red pepper, garlic) was legible; their amounts rest on the description.
Macro panel digits other than the hook's 62g protein never render legibly; calories/carbs/fat are description-only.
Sweet-chilli jam quantity is unstated and excluded from the reported macros.
Lebanese wrap brand/size unstated; the ~200 kcal each figure is creator-reported.

source.quantity_basis: Measurements and approximate per-wrap macros from the public description. Demonstrated steps checked against 83 English automatic-caption segments and sampled source frames (32-frame sweep + 78 + 57 + 22 dense frames + 15 preprocessed). On-screen spice, sauce, bake and kebab-count cards OCR-verified; garbled spice-card lines resolved by a control-proven vision read (token delta +192; receipts in vision/). Sauce card matches the written list line-for-line except the spoken-only splash of water. Louis's parsley swap, sweet-chilli jam and blender shortcut are distinguished from the written method. No macro recalculation; unreadable animated macro digits discarded, not guessed.
